summary: Tested the brokered-CD redesign end to end. Backend: 9 pytest cases, all pass. They cover POST /api/leads with zip_code (stored in the DB; named matches come back sorted by APY), validation (400 when agree=false, 422 for a bad email or a ZIP that is too long), /api/rate-trends, and chat anonymization. Chat did not name a bank on either prompt; one call hit an upstream Gemini 503 and passed on retry. Frontend checks that passed: homepage hero, maturity preview pills, 20 brokered cards, all 3 filters, the inquire button opening the popup with the right term preselected, wizard step validation, invalid ZIP, Back buttons keeping values, and a real wizard submit showing Ally/Barclays/Bask after submit. Also passed: inline form on /best-cd-rates (real submit shows named matches), landing order (inline form, then brokered options, then wizard), the 'CD options today' table with no Bank column, term pages (/best-1-year-cd-rates 4 cards, /best-18-month 2, /best-5-year 2) with wizard, inline form and FDIC strip, the article and guide pages with wizard and inline form, the trends stat card reading 'issuer details upon inquiry', /privacy, /terms, and mobile with no horizontal overflow. No bank names appear before submit on home, landing, term or trends pages. Two leaks were found elsewhere (see action items).

minor.issue: Public and unauthenticated. It returns full named-bank data (bank, apy, url), and the Home (App.jsx:78) and LandingPage fetch it before any submit. Bank names are not shown on the page, but anyone can read them in the network tab or by calling the endpoint, which undercuts the 'reveal only after lead' model.

No bank is named, but the bot quotes the retail rate data, e.g. '4.50% APY with a $0 minimum deposit' for 12 months. This contradicts the site's brokered message ($50,000+ minimums, 12-month options shown at 4.25% or lower). The bot also failed once with an upstream Gemini 503 and recovered on retry.

ui_bugs.issue: Month overflow on the 29th-31st. Today is Oct 31, so +6 months shows 'May 2027' (should be April 2027) and the 18-month cards show 'May 1, 2028' instead of Apr 30, 2028. Clamp the result to the last day of the target month.

integration_issues.flow: No named bank leak before submit
integration_issues.issue: /guides/are-cds-safe FAQ (src/data/guides.js line 549) says 'Ally, Marcus, Capital One, Discover and the others we list all are'. The text is visible on the page and baked into the SSG HTML (build/guides/are-cds-safe/index.html).

integration_issues.flow: No named bank leak before submit
integration_issues.issue: public/llms.txt line 6 says 'Top 12-month CD rate listed: 4.75% APY (Marcus by Goldman Sachs, $500 minimum)'. This public file is stale and names a bank. The rest of the file still describes 'compare rates from top FDIC-insured banks' and a 'live CD rate comparison table'.

issues: The hero still reads 'Every rate below is from an FDIC-insured bank, ranked by APY', which no longer fits anonymous brokered options.

The copy still describes tracking named banks ('6 banks tracked', 'verify CD rates from top FDIC-insured banks'). Its best 12-month APY of 4.50% differs from the brokered 12-month top of 4.25%. The data stories conflict but no bank is named.

The revealed matches are retail named-bank rates (Ally 4.50%). For 5-year terms they are lower than the advertised brokered APYs (up to 5.60%), so users may see a mismatch after submitting. This is a business decision to review. Bank logo circles looked empty in the screenshots, possibly because of loading=lazy.

Update public/llms.txt (and check ai-catalog.json) so it no longer names Marcus and matches the brokered-options positioning

useLeadForm (LeadForm.jsx line 63-67) uses an undefined `open` variable. It currently resolves to window.open, which is always truthy, so it only works by accident. Use a proper param.

critical_code_review_comments: LeadForm.jsx useLeadForm: `open` is not defined in the hook scope, so the effect relies on the global window.open
server.py is 881 lines; consider splitting into routers (leads, chat, admin, rates)
ScoutWizard TERMS has two entries with value 12 ('12 months' and 'Not sure yet'). This is fine, but 'Not sure yet' is silently stored as term_months=12.
Wizard/LeadForm select triggers in LeadForm have no data-testid (the inline form amount, timeframe and term selects)
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test leads via API plus 2 via UI (testwizard-qa@example.com) and deleted them all from db.leads afterwards. Chat test sessions are prefixed TEST_.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The preview ingress returns HTTP 429 when many pages are loaded in a single Playwright run, which leaves the page blank. Load at most 8-10 pages per run and sleep between runs. Term pages: best-1-year and best-6-month are in landings.js; terms.js has 3-month, 18-month, 2-year, 3-year, 5-year and no-penalty. The inline form selects have no testids, so use the button[role=combobox] index inside [data-testid=inline-lead-form]. The brokered term filter labels are '6 months', '9 months', '1 year', '18 months', '2 years', etc.
